CityPress.UI.Settings.Title: Editorial settings
CityPress.UI.Settings.Scope.Label: Scope
CityPress.UI.Settings.Scope.CurrentSave: Currently using: per-save settings. The global default does not override other saves' settings.
CityPress.UI.Settings.AutoGenerate: Publish automatically each day and open in game
CityPress.UI.Settings.Name: Newspaper name
CityPress.UI.Settings.Name.Placeholder: {0} Daily (leave blank to follow city name)
CityPress.UI.Settings.ExportDir.Note: Leave blank to use the CityPress folder in Documents, grouped by newspaper and save. Takes effect after saving; old files stay where they are. “Export current issue” saves a copy to a new folder without calling the API.
CityPress.UI.Settings.Service.Note: Supports Chat Completions-compatible endpoints. Saving stores configuration only; city material is sent when you generate.
CityPress.UI.Settings.Api.Note: Enter a base URL or a full chat/completions URL. Local services may use HTTP.
CityPress.UI.Settings.Model.Placeholder: Model name provided by the service
CityPress.UI.Settings.Key.Configured: A key is configured for this endpoint; leave blank to keep it
CityPress.UI.Settings.Key.New: Enter a key for this endpoint
CityPress.UI.Settings.Key.Note: Keys are encrypted per endpoint and never written to saves. Switching endpoints does not carry the old key; disable authentication for local services that do not require it.
CityPress.UI.Settings.JsonMode.Note: Disable when the service does not support response_format; the model must still return the full JSON newspaper.
CityPress.UI.Settings.LongCommentary: Dedicate a long commentary edition to major events
CityPress.UI.Settings.Layout.Note: Automatically matches banner, lead/sidebar, vertical headline, brief-news, long-commentary and long-commentary-plus-short-comments layouts; variation only picks from suitable templates. The saved composition stays fixed when reading or exporting.
CityPress.UI.Settings.Editorial.Note: Columns, story count, headlines and selection are decided by the editor from the facts. The fixed contract governs output format and factual accuracy only.
CityPress.UI.Settings.Coverage.Note: Tool submissions, observed city changes, events and statistics trends are recorded. Duplicates are merged; automatic vehicle states, boarding/alighting and UI navigation are excluded. Other mods' independent behavior and states shorter than the snapshot interval may be missed.
CityPress.Status.SettingsSaved: Settings saved; the export directory applies to future exports. Existing issues stay in their original location.
CityPress.Status.SettingsInvalid: Settings not saved. Check the API endpoint, parameters and export directory.
CityPress.Status.SettingsFailed: Settings are invalid or could not be written; nothing was saved.
CityPress.Status.ConfigInvalid: API configuration is invalid. Check the service address and parameters in editorial settings.
CityPress.Status.TimeNotReady: City time is not ready yet. Wait until the city finishes loading.
CityPress.Status.Busy: A newspaper is already being processed. Please wait.
CityPress.Status.Generating: The editorial desk is preparing the newspaper…
CityPress.Status.NoHistory: There are no valid collected records for that historical date.
CityPress.Status.ExportFolderInvalid: The export directory is invalid. Change it in editorial settings.
CityPress.Status.ExportDone: Newspaper exported; no API call was made.
CityPress.Status.LocalOnly: No publishable events on this day; a short issue was exported without an API call.
CityPress.Status.CacheReused: Reused the local draft and exported it.

CityPress.Status.ArchiveListFailed: Could not read the archive list.
CityPress.Status.FolderOpenFailed: Could not open the folder. Check the path and access permissions.
CityPress.Status.JournalFailed: Journal backup failed; it will be retried later.
CityPress.Status.GenerationFailed: Generation or export failed ({0}). Check directory permissions; the draft cache was kept.
CityPress.Coverage.Waiting: City observation: waiting for the save to load
CityPress.Coverage.Summary: City observation: {0} objects, {1} statistics; staged reconciliation, peak collection slice {2} ms
CityPress.Error.CityTime: City time is not ready; cannot generate a newspaper for that date.
CityPress.Error.InputTooLarge: This day's complete material exceeds the single-edit capacity. All local records were kept; nothing was truncated and no API request was sent.
CityPress.Error.ApiKeyMissing: Configure an API key for this endpoint, or disable key authentication for a local service that does not require it.
CityPress.Error.MissingBreakthrough: The returned draft omits a major breakthrough. Nothing was cached; generate again.
CityPress.Error.CommentaryCopy: The independent commentary repeats the news copy too closely and was not published. Nothing was cached; you can generate again.
CityPress.Error.QualityFailed: The draft did not pass fact and quality checks: {0}. Nothing was published; you can generate again.
CityPress.Error.MissingMajorNews: The returned draft has no news article for the major event. Please retry.
CityPress.Error.MissingMajorCommentary: The returned draft omits commentary or analysis for the major event. Please retry.
CityPress.Error.MissingCommentaryEdition: The major news issue has no independent commentary edition. Nothing was cached; generate again.
CityPress.Error.MissingLongCommentary: The major news issue has no independent long commentary; a short-comments-only edition is not enough. Nothing was cached; generate again.
CityPress.Error.TransitOpeningMissing: The draft omits a confirmed new line opening. Nothing was cached; generate again.
CityPress.Error.CommentaryFailed: Major news is missing commentary or analysis; the independent commentary could not be written: {0}. Nothing was published; you can generate again.
CityPress.Error.CommentaryJson: The model's commentary is not valid JSON.
CityPress.Error.CommentaryShape: The model did not return a complete commentary title and body.
CityPress.Error.PaperJson: The model output is not a valid JSON newspaper. Check the model, JSON mode and editorial policy.
CityPress.Error.PaperEmpty: The model returned no newspaper content. Please retry.
CityPress.Error.ApiTimeout: The API request timed out. Increase the wait time in settings.
CityPress.Error.ApiHttp: API request failed (HTTP {0}). Check the address, model, authentication and parameter compatibility.
CityPress.Error.ApiResponseJson: The API response is not JSON. Check the compatible endpoint address.
CityPress.Error.ApiStructure: The API response is not a compatible Chat Completions text response.
CityPress.Error.ApiTruncated: The newspaper was not generated completely. Increase the output limit or shorten the editorial policy and retry.
CityPress.Status.ExportDeferred: Newspaper ready to read. Some files could not be saved; use Export to retry.
CityPress.Status.ExportRenamed: Newspaper saved. The existing Word file could not be replaced; a new copy was saved.
